'''Jadae Fox''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Ohio State Championship]] on 21 April 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Speed Profit]], according to Brad Eier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2120">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-ohio-states-4-21-01d2120/ ohio-states-4-21-01], DeckTech (brad "swccguy" eier, 22 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-ohio-states-4-21-01d2120/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
